/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
src = Path('Physlib/Electromagnetism/Dynamics/IsExtrema.lean').read_text()
start = src.index('lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema')
end = src.index('\\n\\nend ElectromagneticPotential', start)
decl = src[start:end]
old = '''  calc _
    _= ∂ₜ (fun t =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, Space.deriv j (fun x => magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c A t x (j, i)) x -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity 𝓕.c J t x i) t := by
        conv_lhs =>
          enter [1]
          change fun t => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) t
          enter [t]
          rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
            (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
            time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∂ₜ (fun t => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x) t -
'''
new = '''  have hfirst : (fun s : Time => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) s) =
      (fun s => 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j,
        Space.deriv j (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity 𝓕.c J s x i) := by
    funext s
    exact time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h s x i
  rw [hfirst]
  calc
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∂ₜ (fun t => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x) t -
'''
assert old in decl
decl = decl.replace(old, new, 1)
Path('candidate.lean').write_text(decl)
PY
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"
